best_for: RoomLimit sets what a site provides for a Purified Water package as the room the package goes in: an isometric cutaway of the room with the package on its base frame, a dash-and-dot battery-limit line on the floor round it, and every connection the site provides as a tie-in where its run crosses the line, numbered to the rows beside the drawing.
